english.title: UAS operator cause or permit tethered small aircraft to be flown in breach of registration regulation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a UAS operator, caused or permitted a tethered small unmanned aircraft to be flown when the requirements of Article 14(5) of the Unmanned Aircraft Implementing Regulation relating to registration were not complied with in relation to that aircraft in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 265E(1)(a) and (7) and 265F(5)(b)(i) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
